sloka: स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ।। ६.५८.५५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa gatāsurgataśrīko gatasattvo gatendriyaḥ ।papāta sahasā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ ।। 6.58.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Hurled by Neela, the foremost of monkeys, the huge rock broke the head of Prahastha into pieces.
